summary: Heritage Foods completed the acquisition of the remaining 5.60% equity in Heritage Novandie Foods, increasing its stake to 100% effective October 16, 2026.

headline: GPT Infraprojects wins ₹149.5 crore railway contract
summary: GPT Infraprojects secures a ₹149.5 crore signaling contract from CSTE, Western Railway, adding to its order book in the railway infrastructure segment.

summary: Epsilon Bidco Pte. Ltd. requested reclassification from promoter to public category after selling 26.37% stake in EPL Limited via on-market trades.

headline: Jojo Ltd board approves Dubai entity incorporation
summary: Jojo Limited's board approved incorporating a private company, Jojo Holdings Ltd., in the Dubai International Financial Centre. The move is currently at the proposal stage.

headline: Sky Gold & Diamonds appoints new internal auditor

headline: Ganesha Ecosphere subsidiary gets FSSAI nod for rPET
summary: Ganesha Ecopet, a wholly owned subsidiary of Ganesha Ecosphere, secured FSSAI approval for its fourth food-grade rPET production line in Telangana.

summary: Leo Dryfruits & Spices Trading Ltd board approved a fresh preferential issue of 70 lakh warrants at ₹60 each, raising up to ₹42 crore. The move supersedes an earlier proposal and targets public investors.

headline: Aadhar Housing Finance Chairperson Raj Vikash Verma dies
summary: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited confirmed the demise of Raj Vikash Verma, Independent Director and Non-Executive Chairperson, on October 16, 2026. The company cited this as an irreparable loss.

headline: Invicta Capserv raises stake in Methodhub Software
summary: Invicta Capserv Private Limited acquired 18,000 equity shares of Methodhub Software Ltd via open market. The acquisition pushed the group's holding to 5.062%.

headline: VS Holding BV cuts Denis Chem stake to 14.41%
summary: VS Holding BV reduced its equity stake in Denis Chem Lab Ltd by 2.05% through open market sales between September and October 2026, bringing its holding down to 14.41%.

summary: SBI Funds Management received a request from State Bank of India to reclassify Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation from Promoter Group to Public category under SEBI norms.

headline: Lincoln Pharma adopts FY26 results, declares ₹1.80 dividend
summary: Lincoln Pharmaceuticals approved audited financials for FY26 and declared a final dividend of ₹1.80 per share. The AGM also ratified director re-appointments and cost auditor remuneration.

headline: Bright Outdoor Media H1FY27 Results
summary: Bright Outdoor Media reported standalone net profit of ₹1,102.71 lakh for H1FY27, up 9.4% YoY. Revenue from operations rose 13.9% to ₹7,119.36 lakh.

summary: MethodHub Software Ltd reported a 145.5% YoY revenue increase to ₹3,345.61 million in FY26. EBITDA margin expanded to 20.06%, driven by AI platform growth and acquisitions.

headline: Vaxfab appoints Dhruvi Patel as CS, Bardia resigns
summary: Vaxfab Enterprises appointed Mrs. Dhruvi Patel as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 16, 2026. Mrs. Neha Rishabh Bardia resigned from the role citing personal reasons.

headline: Tejas Networks Q2 revenue up 53% to ₹4 billion
summary: Tejas Networks reported Q2 revenue of ₹4 billion, up from ₹2.62 billion YoY. Net loss narrowed to ₹2.06 billion from ₹3.07 billion in the prior year.

headline: Vodafone Idea appoints Manoj Murali as COO
summary: Vodafone Idea has appointed Manoj Murali as its Chief Operating Officer, with the role effective from October 19, 2026.

headline: Jain Resource Recycling seeks shareholder approval for director appointments
summary: Jain Resource Recycling Limited has initiated a postal ballot for remote e-voting on the appointment of two independent directors and alterations to its Memorandum of Association.

headline: Retaggio Industries buys property for ₹10 crore
summary: Retaggio Industries acquires commercial property from M S Mody Builders for ₹10 crore to support business expansion plans.

headline: Fischer Medical seeks shareholder nod for ₹350 crore NCD issuance
summary: Fischer Medical Ventures Ltd has initiated a postal ballot process to seek approval for raising ₹350 crore via non-convertible debentures. The proposal includes pledging promoter shares and assets of key subsidiaries as security.

headline: Acme Resources CS resigns effective Oct 15, 2026
summary: Amanpreet Kaur resigned as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of Acme Resources Ltd due to personal reasons. The company is appointing a replacement.

summary: Bajaj Finserv discloses September 2026 premiums. Life insurance new business up 33% YoY to ₹1,830.86 crore; general insurance gross premium rises 6.5% to ₹2,363 crore.

summary: Magnum Ventures Ltd will hold NCLT-directed meetings on November 20, 2026, to approve its scheme of arrangement with Magnum Paperz Ltd. The cut-off date for voting rights is November 13, 2026.

headline: Torrent Pharma ED Amal Kelshikar resigns
summary: Amal Kelshikar, Executive Director at Torrent Pharmaceuticals, resigned effective October 16, 2026. The move follows his extended tenure beyond superannuation.

summary: Aris International Limited appointed Hemant Kumar and Kunal Khaitan as additional non-executive independent directors for five-year terms, subject to shareholder approval.

headline: REC subsidiary sells SPV for ₹18.44 crore
summary: RECPDCL transferred 100% stake in Nawada Durgapur Power Transmission Ltd to Shivalaya Construction for ₹18.44 crore, exiting the project SPV.

headline: Venus Remedies secures 5 approvals in 4 markets
summary: Venus Remedies Limited obtained marketing authorisations for Vancomycin, Fluorouracil, Fulvestrant, Methotrexate, and Meropenem in Kazakhstan, Peru, Kuwait, and Argentina.

headline: Homre Ltd Q2FY27 Results: Net profit rises 325% YoY
summary: Homre Ltd reported a standalone net profit of ₹68.46 lakh for Q2FY27, up 325% YoY. Revenue from operations surged to ₹2,094.86 lakh, driven by trading activities.

headline: AxisCades appoints Uttam Kumar Bhageria as CFO-Designate
summary: AxisCades Technologies appoints Uttam Kumar Bhageria as CFO-Designate effective Oct 21, 2026. He will assume full CFO role after current CFO Shashidhar SK retires in Dec 2026.

headline: Mafatlal Industries signs MoU for combat uniform fabric supply
summary: Mafatlal Industries Limited signed an MoU with the Air Force Wives Welfare Association to supply combat uniform fabric, reinforcing its integrated uniforms strategy.

headline: HSCL Q2 profit up 29% to ₹2.32B
summary: Himadri Speciality Chemical reported Q2 net profit of ₹2.32 billion, up 29% YoY. Revenue rose 58% to ₹16.91 billion, though EBITDA margins contracted.

headline: ICICI Pru AMC to hold US roadshow Nov 2-6
summary: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited will participate in a non-deal US roadshow from November 2 to November 6, 2026. The event includes one-to-one and group meetings in person.

headline: Landsmill Green withdraws promoter reclassification
summary: Landsmill Green Limited withdrew its application to reclassify promoter shares to public category under SEBI Reg 31A, following requests from promoters.

headline: Kirloskar Brothers passes special resolution for director appointment
summary: Kirloskar Brothers Limited shareholders approved the appointment of Dr. Madhuri Kanitkar as Independent Director via postal ballot, with non-promoter votes showing strong support.

headline: Clean Max approves sale of 26% stake in subsidiary
summary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Ltd approved the sale of 26% stake in Clean Max Hachi Private Limited to Chambal Fertilisers for ₹26,000.

summary: Calcutta High Court sets aside IT reassessment for Tega McNally Minerals for AY 2017-18, removing a ₹13.79 crore demand risk.

summary: B-Right RealEstate reported Q2FY27 pre-sales of ₹54.94 crore, up 994% YoY. Collections rose 747% to ₹68.64 crore, with H1 pre-sales at ₹235.88 crore.

summary: ICICI Prudential AMC expects FY27 ESOP expenses of ₹64-68 crore, plans to acquire PMS from ICICI Securities adding ~₹3,000 crore AUM, and is launching a fifth SIF fund this quarter.

headline: Anuh Pharma acquires facility from Vanquest for ₹72.90 crore
summary: Anuh Pharma has signed a deal to acquire a manufacturing facility from Vanquest Pharma for ₹72.90 crore, marking a significant capacity expansion move.

headline: Nexus Select Trust shifts Q2FY27 earnings call time
summary: Nexus Select Trust revised its Q2FY27 earnings conference call to 16:30 IST on November 3, 2026. The change was notified to NSE and BSE, with dial-in details provided for investors.

headline: Qualitek Labs approves preferential share issue
summary: Qualitek Labs shareholders approved special resolutions for issuing 3.86 lakh equity shares and 5.2 lakh warrants on a preferential basis during an EGM held via video conferencing.

headline: J&K Bank sells 0.5% stake in PNB MetLife for ₹120.10 crore
summary: Jammu & Kashmir Bank has divested a 0.5% stake in PNB MetLife India Insurance to MetLife International Holdings for ₹120.10 crore.

headline: Indian Hotels fined ₹10 lakh by BMC for NOC lapse
summary: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation imposed a ₹10,00,000 penalty on Indian Hotels Company Limited for lacking an Estate Department NOC despite having building approvals.

summary: Abril Paper Tech Ltd received a communication for a personal hearing on October 22, 2026, regarding a CGST show cause notice for alleged short payment of taxes.

summary: Camlin Fine Sciences shareholders passed a resolution appointing Atul Pradhan as Non-Executive Independent Director. The vote secured 99.97% support from polled votes during the postal ballot concluded on October 16, 2026.

headline: Arman Financial appoints Akkiraju as CBO of Namra Finance

headline: Containe Tech CS Nikitha Sarda resigns
summary: Nikitha Sarda resigned as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of Containe Technologies Ltd on October 16, 2026, citing personal pre-occupations.

headline: AstraZeneca Pharma India opens new Mumbai office
summary: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited inaugurated a 25,600 sq ft corporate office in Mumbai to support its growing clinical trial and commercial operations.

summary: Artson Limited reported a net profit of ₹200.62 lakh in Q2FY27, reversing a loss from the previous year. Revenue fell 19.6% YoY to ₹38.68 crore.

headline: Poonawalla Fincorp seeks shareholder nod for director re-appointment
summary: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has issued a postal ballot notice for the re-appointment of Independent Director Kemisha Soni. E-voting runs from October 17 to November 15, 2026.

headline: South Indian Bank releases Q2FY27 earnings call recording
summary: South Indian Bank has made the audio recording of its investor conference call available online. The call was held on October 16, 2026, following regulatory disclosures.

headline: Advit Jewels hosts investor meet on Oct 24
summary: Advit Jewels Limited will host a physical investor and analyst meeting in Jaipur on October 24, 2026. The event includes factory visits and one-to-one meetings.

headline: Aurum PropTech confirms use of ₹343.56 crore rights issue funds
summary: Aurum PropTech has confirmed the proper utilisation of ₹343.56 crore raised through its rights issue, as reported for the period ending September 30, 2026.

headline: Jain Resource Recycling gives ₹150 crore guarantee
summary: Jain Resource Recycling has extended corporate guarantees worth ₹150 crore in favour of its subsidiary Jain Green Technologies.

headline: G R Infraprojects gets High Court order quashing GST notice
summary: The Madhya Pradesh High Court quashed a GST show cause notice issued to G R Infraprojects. The order resolves litigation initiated in August 2026.

headline: Hittco Tools plans fund raise, UAE subsidiary
summary: Hittco Tools Ltd board to meet Oct 22, 2026, to approve equity issue, name change, UAE subsidiary formation, and stake acquisition.

headline: Rollatainers gets in-principle approval for warrants
summary: BSE and NSE grant in-principle approval for Rollatainers to issue 35.87 crore warrants convertible into equity at ₹2.23 per share on a preferential basis.

headline: Taylormade Renewables plans fund raise via board meeting
summary: Taylormade Renewables Ltd board meeting on Oct 19, 2026, to consider raising funds through equity, debt, or warrants. Trading window closed for insiders.

headline: SG Finserve shares earnings call recording link
summary: SG Finserve Limited released the audio recording link for its Q2FY26 earnings conference call held on October 16, 2026. The filing confirms compliance with SEBI regulations.

headline: Galaxy Agrico board to consider MD resignation, new appointment
summary: Galaxy Agrico Exports Ltd board meeting on Oct 21, 2026, will review Prashant Sudhir Khairnar's resignation as MD and Gaurang Shah's appointment.

headline: IndiaNivesh board reshuffles committees, appoints new director
summary: IndiaNivesh Limited approved the resignation of Jagdish Prasad Ridhkaran Pareek and appointed Sanjay Ramdhari Yadav as Additional Non-Executive Independent Director.

headline: Tiger Logistics Q2FY27: PAT down 32% YoY
summary: Tiger Logistics reported a 32% YoY decline in net profit to ₹584.77 lakh despite 33% revenue growth. Operating cash flow turned negative at ₹1,918.64 lakh.

headline: Emkay Global gets NSE listing approval for 1 lakh shares
summary: NSE granted in-principle approval for 1,00,000 equity shares allotted to promoter Prakash Kacholia via warrant conversion. Listing effective upon depository confirmation.

headline: Hero MotoCorp launches Xtreme 160R 4V and 250R
summary: Hero MotoCorp introduces the all-new Xtreme 160R 4V and refreshed Xtreme 250R, featuring advanced tech like cruise control and FSD suspension to boost premium sales.

summary: Ascensive Educare Limited informed BSE that Regulation 23(9) of SEBI LODR does not apply for the half year ended September 30, 2026, citing its status as a BSE Startup.

headline: GRSE appoints Dharminder Kumar as Independent Director
summary: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd appointed Dharminder Kumar as Part-time Non-Official Director (Independent Director) effective October 16, 2026, for a three-year term.

headline: KFin Technologies appoints Srinivas Yadav Karri as Group CISO
summary: KFin Technologies Ltd appointed Srinivas Yadav Karri as Group Chief Information Security Officer effective October 16, 2026, to centralize cyber risk oversight.

summary: The National Green Tribunal disposed of a case against Bharat Coking Coal Ltd alleging illegal mining, citing parallel jurisdiction with the Jharkhand High Court.

headline: Samvardhana Motherson: Yachiyo Canada to dissolve
summary: Samvardhana Motherson International has received consent for the dissolution of its indirect subsidiary Yachiyo Canada, effective October 14, 2026.

headline: Blue Star shareholders approve Nikhilesh Panchal as Independent Director
summary: Blue Star Limited shareholders approved the appointment of Nikhilesh Panchal as Independent Director via postal ballot. The resolution passed with 81.78% votes in favour.

headline: Lloyds Engg holds shareholder meet for merger
summary: Lloyds Engineering Works held a virtual meeting to approve the merger of three subsidiaries. Voting results to be announced within two days.

headline: Embassy Office Parks REIT redeems ₹1,100 crore NCDs
summary: Embassy Office Parks REIT has completed the redemption of ₹1,100 crore worth of non-convertible debentures, marking a significant debt repayment milestone.

headline: GMR Airports September traffic up 0.9% YoY to 9.2 million
summary: GMR Airports recorded 9.2 million passengers in September, up 0.9% YoY, while H1FY27 cumulative traffic surpassed 58.2 million, marking a record half-year performance.

headline: Aegis Logistics to host investor meet in Singapore
summary: Aegis Logistics officials will participate in an investor meet in Singapore on October 22, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price sensitive information will be discussed.

headline: NBCC issues corrigendum to MCA merger order
summary: NBCC (India) Limited filed a corrigendum to the MCA's first motion order regarding its merger with HSCC (India) Limited. The amendment clarifies board approval dates and affidavit authorizations.

headline: KSB wins ₹85 crore order from ONGC
summary: KSB has secured an order worth around ₹85 crore from ONGC to replace seven main injection pumps, marking a significant contract win in the oil and gas segment.

headline: RBI approves merger of Emirates NBD's Indian branches
summary: The Reserve Bank of India has approved the merger of Emirates NBD Bank's Indian branches with RBL Bank, effective December 1, 2026.

headline: Jetking sells Delhi offices for ₹4.16 crore
summary: Jetking Infotrain sold eight office units in Laxmi Nagar, Delhi, for ₹4.16 crore. The company executed lease deeds to continue using the premises for business operations.

headline: Lemon Tree subsidiary gets partial GST relief
summary: Fleur Hotels, a material subsidiary of Lemon Tree Hotels, received a partial allowance on its GST appeal. The appellate authority ruled that interest liability on irregular Input Tax Credit will not arise.
